I get this panic-y feeling that I might choke or throw up, especially if I’m rushed. Sometimes I’ll pick at things or wait until later to eat when I’m alone, but I’m not totally avoiding food or anything. It’s more like this constant low-level dread that something might go wrong when I eat.

It’s been maybe… six months? It’s hard to pin down exactly, but it’s gotten more noticeable lately.

I’m on TV every night, so I’m used to stress, but this is different. Any time there’s a health segment and they roll footage of surgeries or even needles, I feel this rush of heat, my stomach flips, and my vision kind of goes fuzzy. If there’s blood on screen, I have to look away, pretend I’m checking notes. When I had to get my flu shot for work, I nearly passed out. I made one of the producers come with me and just talk the whole time so I could get through it. If I go to the doctor, I need someone on the phone or in the waiting room; otherwise I start panicking before they even touch me.

Food has gotten weird, too. I used to love trying new restaurants after the late show, but now I’m overly cautious. I catch myself cutting things into tiny pieces, chewing forever because I’m scared of choking or throwing up on air the next day. I’ve been skipping certain meals before broadcasts “just in case,” though I’m not entirely sure what I’m afraid will happen. I just… don’t feel relaxed around eating the way I used to.

I guess this all really started getting bad maybe 5–6 months ago. I’ve always been a little uneasy around deep water and big storms, but lately it’s like my body just freaks out. If I even think about driving past the river at night or if the forecast says there might be heavy rain, I’ll rearrange my whole day—cancel farm calls, reschedule surgeries, whatever—just so I don’t have to be out in it. A couple of clients have complained because I wouldn’t come out during a storm, even for emergencies, and my boss has noticed.

Food has become its own problem. I’ve had a few episodes where I felt like I might choke or throw up while eating, and since then I’ve gotten really tense around certain foods and in some eating situations—like if it’s something harder to chew, or if I’m eating with other people. Sometimes I just pick at my food or skip meals because I don’t want to deal with that panicky feeling. I know I’m eating less than I used to, but I keep telling myself I’m just being cautious, even though it’s starting to affect my energy at work.
